errors.evidence: The description states there are three feature extraction methods, but the legend and chart clearly show four categories: "无", "i-vector", "d-vector", and "s-vector". The description omits the "无" (light green) category entirely.
The horizontal axis has categorical labels: "Test1", "Test2", "Test3", "Test4", and "Test5".
The description maps "s-vector" to "green" and then proceeds to read the values from the light green bars, which actually correspond to the "无" category. The dark green bars correspond to "s-vector".

errors.text_span: 在 Test1 中，s-vector 的柱状图最高，约为 35%，而 i-vector 的柱状图最低，约为 30%
errors.evidence: This statement is entirely incorrect. In Test1, the highest bar is "无" (approx. 36%), not "s-vector". The lowest bar is "s-vector" (approx. 25%), not "i-vector" (approx. 30%). The description confuses the "s-vector" bars with the "无" bars.
